name: Запуск, регистрация и вход

emailRegistration: atomic users and initial legalAcceptanceLogs batch
principal-scoped optional consent and app-lock choice
federated: verified existing profile or mandatory registration completion

roleCoverage.policySource: Owner/admin require current protected session. Ordinary user, moderator and organization roles use common auth flow without global privileged MFA solely because of organization access.
roleCoverage.tests: Role policy and session tests plus owner UI gate; this is not a live sign-in for every real role.

issues.finding: A suspended old-owner MFA check can present privilegedMultiFactorRequirement after a newer ordinary user has signed in.
issues.reproductionResult: 44 existing tests passed; diagnostic auditLateProtectionCheckCannotAffectNewAccount failed with new-user authenticated and privilegedMultiFactorRequirement presented.
issues.proposal: Fence protected-session checks by auth transition generation and principal before and after every suspension.
issues.securityBoundary: Diagnostic reproduced an unwanted gate; it did not reproduce user identity substitution or server authorization bypass.

issues.finding: Email, federated and passkey controls have independent busy flags. Cross-method actions and navigation can start while a different sign-in method is in progress.
issues.proposal: Coordinate pending authentication across controls, reject duplicate submissions, preserve a clear recoverable cancellation path.

issues.finding: Restoration awaits reload, forced token refresh, private profile and recoverable public-profile repair before publishing the session. Registration document loads and auth restoration lack an application-level end-to-end wait limit.
issues.proposal: Move recoverable projection repair off the critical path with principal fencing; coalesce document requests; add bounded recovery states without allowing late auth side effects or bypassing authoritative access checks.
issues.boundary: Code-derived critical-path risk, not a measured production latency attribution. Legal access checks remain required.

issues.finding: Field placeholders are faint in light and dark themes; reset password repeats its title; method ordering differs across entry screens. Native Apple sign-in label remains German in the Ukrainian custom-language UI.
issues.proposal: Use readable explicit field prompts/labels, simplify headings and instructions, keep consistent method order, resolve native button language using supported localization behavior. Long consent explanations should remain fully accessible while allowing a shorter summary and expandable details; do not reduce supported accessibility font sizes.

issues.finding: Federated and passkey UI collapse most failures to one generic message; verification recheck after an external email confirmation is manual.
issues.proposal: Distinguish connectivity, service, throttling and cancellation; recheck pending verification on return from background with duplicate protection.

limitations: Real Apple/Google/iCloud passkey sign-ins and email delivery were not exercised on a physical device.
Production Identity Platform config/provider read attempts returned HTTP 403 with the current gcloud identity; provider enablement is not live-confirmed in this audit.
UI uses deterministic simulator fixtures; production mutations were not made.
Block remains open pending approved implementation and regression verification.
